Supreme Court Clarifies States Can Withdraw FIRs Against Student Protesters

The Supreme Court clarified on Tuesday that states have the liberty to withdraw First Information Reports (FIRs) filed against student protesters, provided they do not have criminal antecedents. This clarification came during hearings related to student protests. Some outlets also reported on specific actions, such as the Gujarat government ordering the withdrawal of cases against NEET paper leak protesters. Separately, the Youth Congress demanded the resignation of Amit Shah over alleged actions against student protesters. Another report mentioned student claims of glitches in the NEET re-exam, despite government boasting.
